scope: Profile and Privacy. The deployed evidence is from the original local deployment. The current shared-token contract is verified separately in local tests.

threats.threat: A Student calls Alumni profile operations
threats.control: Signed user token verified by shared/auth.js plus backend role check

threats.threat: An Alumni supplies a different owner or profile ID
threats.control: Owner taken from token sub, supported body field allowlist and /me routes

threats.threat: Search reveals email for a pending or unrelated request
threats.control: Search credential and delegated signed Student token, matching accepted consent in database
threats.test: Pending contact denied; Different Student denied

threats.threat: A suspended user reuses an unexpired token
threats.control: Live Identity eligibility lookup before protected actions and contact disclosure

threats.threat: Locations fails during a multi-field edit
threats.control: Bounded HTTP timeout before the profile transaction, no partial profile save

threats.threat: Runtime database compromise exposes identity passwords or changes status
threats.control: Separate database login with column-scoped identity reads and no users updates

threats.threat: A client injects SQL or stored scripts through profile input
threats.control: Parameterized SQL, input lengths and types, browser input values/textContent
threats.limitation: Dedicated SQL injection and browser stored-XSS probes remain to be added to the group security pack

threats.threat: A hidden field is inferred through directory filters
threats.control: Privacy choices default hidden, explicit owner-only updates
threats.limitation: Actual directory response and filter enforcement awaits Ammar's code

threats.threat: Credentials leak through frontend or logs
threats.control: Ignored environment files, public-only S3 configuration, sanitized status/request-ID logging
threats.evidence: Runtime secrets excluded from S3 uploads and log payloads

operationalLimits: Floci uses local HTTP and simulated IAM, so cloud TLS and encryption-at-rest are deployment controls to document separately.
Actual teammate endpoint contracts remain unconfirmed.
The final report must include each student's own evidence and contribution statement.
